# Ecomail
> Email marketing platform for newsletters, automations and SMS campaigns.
## Pages
- [Ecomail.app | Email and omni-channel marketing platform](https://ecomail.app/): Platform for Emailing, SMS, Facebook & Instagram campaigns. Advanced automation, free start, unlimited emails, easy migration. Try now!
- [About Ecomail](https://ecomail.app/about-ecomail/): Get to know our story, our team and the values we build on. At Ecomail, we help create better email marketing - simply, efficiently and with a personal touch.
- [Become a certified partner](https://ecomail.app/certification/): Marketing agencies and specialists can become an Ecomail partner. Get your email marketing certificate and reach new clients.
- [Ecomail.app | Email and omni-channel marketing platform](https://ecomail.app/changelog/): Platform for Emailing, SMS, Facebook & Instagram campaigns. Advanced automation, free start, unlimited emails, easy migration. Try now!
- [Contact us](https://ecomail.app/contact/): Professional customer support is available via online chat or email support@ecomail.cz | Reach out, we will be happy to hear from you.
- [Maximize sales with email marketing](https://ecomail.app/email-marketing-for-ecommerce/): Advanced email marketing for e-shops. Easy integration with Ecomail, automated emailing, artificial intelligence and other features to increase sales.
- [All features for email marketing](https://ecomail.app/features/): Drag & drop editor, free templates, Facebook campaigns, automation, pop-ups, A/B testing, and advanced stats. Everything you need to grow your audience!
- [Try the FREE tool for your e-mailing](https://ecomail.app/free/): Test what Ecomail can do. Drag & drop editor for newsletter creation, pop-up forms, automation, segmentation, A/B testing and many more features.
- [Boost E-commerce Success: Free Insights](https://ecomail.app/insights/): Gain an unfair advantage in the competitive e-commerce arena with our free newsletter full of exclusive and data-driven insights.
- [Pricing and plans - Start for Free](https://ecomail.app/pricing/): Activate a 14-day trial! Free plans for up to 40,000 contacts, unlimited emails, all features included. No fees. Easy migration & onboarding. Try now!
- [Create and send newsletters easily](https://ecomail.app/sending-newsletter/): Design and send a successful newsletter with Ecomail. Fast, simple, and affordable—even for beginners! Tailor it to your needs effortlessly.

Database segmentation

Smart features 
 
for even better results
 
The easy path to successful campaigns leads through Ecomail. Discover a range of email features that you can master in no time
Try for FREE
Explore features
 
Powerful campaigns
The first step to success. Create and send newsletters that 
 have value and bring results.
Email campaigns
 
Create a designed newsletter in our editor exactly to your liking. 
 
No coding required
, just space for your creativity.
 
More about campaigns
Automation
 
Design scenarios with emails that react to customer behavior in real‑time. Thanks to a simple builder and ready‑made templates, it's a breeze.
 
More about automation
AI features
 
Chat with artificial intelligence directly in the template editor and create campaigns that truly grab attention. AI will help you come up with a catchy subject line, fine‑tune the text in your newsletter, or write descriptions for products in your e‑shop.
Personalization
 
Customize the content of your email for each subscriber and increase your chances of success. Add a greeting, a nearby pickup location, or recommend suitable products based on shopping behavior.
Smarter databases
Perfectly targeted. Collect 
 new contacts and reach out to them 
 with what they are interested in.
Collecting contacts
 
Pop‑up windows, static forms, or slide‑out 
 bars. Place elements on your website that will attract visitors and turn them into customers.
 
More about collecting contacts
Segmentation
 
Reach relevant audiences with your campaigns. Adapt content and frequency to individual segments. The key audiences will be right at your fingertips — the app will automatically divide your database according to who is most active or who to focus on.
Easier data management
No more guessing. Get to know your customers and fine‑tune your emailing 
 according to their preferences.
Campaign reports
 
Track the results of sent campaigns with detailed statistics. In addition to open rate, click rate, and conversions, you can 
 find out whether your recipients are opening emails on a desktop or a mobile device. Compare yourself with your competitors using benchmarks.
Integrations & API
 
Transfer your customer data from e‑shop platforms, CRM, or other tools to Ecomail and make the most of it. We have more than 40 integrations and an open API for custom connections.
 
More about integrations
A/B testing
 
Hesitating about which campaign variant is better? Test it directly on your audience. Compare two email subject lines, sender names, or newsletter templates.
Deliverability proven by clients
Deliverability proven by clients
You don't have to worry about your reputation. We have the experience and cutting‑edge technology used for sending 40% of commercial emails worldwide. We deliver emails to 
160 countries with a 99.97% deliverability rate
.
 
We switched to Ecomail from Mailchimp and the move quickly proved to be successful.
More user-friendly environment, excellent editor, detailed reporting and better deliverability.
Iva Ulčáková
Senior Online Marketing Specialist
Send successful campaigns 
with ease
Send successful campaigns 
with ease
Simply. Effectively. With results after the very first send.

# Pricing
## Plans (regular sending)
Prices depend on the number of active contacts in your database. The default (lowest) prices are shown below.
---
### Profi
**Core features** for smart emailing. Easy newsletter creation and sending.
| Payment | Price |
|---|---|
| Yearly (billed monthly) | $16.67 |
| Monthly | $20 |
**Savings with yearly payment:** 17 %
**Includes:**
- **Unlimited emails**
- Drag & drop template editor
- 170+ design templates
- AI subject generation and text editing
**Does not include:** E-commerce integration, Discount coupons, Customer behavior automation
---
### Marketer+
**Advanced features** especially suitable for e-commerce. Data-driven emailing.
| Payment | Price |
|---|---|
| Yearly (billed monthly) | $25 |
| Monthly | $30 |
**Savings with yearly payment:** 17 %
**Includes everything from Profi +:**
- **Unlimited emails**
- Drag & drop template editor
- 170+ design templates
- AI subject generation and text editing
- E-commerce integration
- Discount coupons
- Customer behavior automation
---
### Ecomail free
**Essential features** for smart emailing. Fully functional for testing or smaller campaigns.
**Includes:**
- **Up to 200 emails sent monthly**
- Drag & drop template editor
- 170+ design templates
- AI subject generation and text editing
- E-commerce integration
- Discount coupons
- Customer behavior automation
---

## Terms
- **Minimum duration of a paid plan:** 3 months
- **Pausing a plan:** once a year, for up to 6 months
- **Free:** **Up to 200 emails sent monthly**
- **Payment:** USD
---
## Contact and sign-up
- Web: https://ecomail.app
- Pricing: https://ecomail.app/pricing/
- Sign up: https://ecomail.app/register/
- For large databases (50,000+ contacts): custom offer at https://ecomail.app/pricing/
